Following deployment of the first vehicle, during in-house testing, corrosion was detected on the vehicle’s manifolds, which affected coating integrity. To address the issue, the FCe™80 power plant was sent to US Hybrid’s South Windsor, CT facility for manifold upgrades. During the removal of the fuel cell engine, rust and debris were found in the cooling system, likely due to incomplete flushing or aging of the old radiator, as the system is a repower from a 2012 truck. The cooling lines were replaced and the system was re-flushed to ensure no debris or contamination remained in the cooling system.
